text:
alex: Heads-up: proposing we remove the runtime pin for v3.2.1 on the EU canary tonight at 22:45 UTC. Fix for the kernel regression landed in 3.2.1+patch and CI looks green. Plan is a cautious 5% roll for 30m, then hold and observe.
maria: Sounds good. Can QA run the extended longseq + perf suite during the hold?
emily-qa: On it. Kicking off longseq with KV-heavy prompts against cohort A (eu). Command: `./scripts/run_longseq.sh --cohort=A --region=eu --duration=45m`. Will upload artifacts to the artifact store.
jun: I want an automated safety hook. I'll add an alert that triggers auto-pin if the unpinned path hits either error_rate>1.5% for 3m or p99>450ms for 5m. If triggered, deploy-bot should pin back and page #eng-oncall.
sam: FYI SDK compatibility: python-sdk 0.12.0 renames the kv-cache header to `X-RW-KV` in requests. Our integration tests passed but callers using raw headers may need a migration note. I'll draft a short blurb for the changelog.
alex: Good catch. Docs team, please add an upgrade note for SDK and the header change.
docs-bot: @sam acknowledged. I'll add a sentence to the runtime changelog and docs migration page. Link placeholder: https://docs.internal/upgrade/runtime-3-2-1
deploy-bot: action queued: unpin runtime v3.2.1 (eu-canary cohort A) at 22:45 UTC. Command preview: `deploybot --action unpin --runtime v3.2.1 --cohort eu-canary --percent 5 --hold 1800 --auto-pin-alerts "error>0.015:3m,p99>450:5m"`
maria: ETA for longseq artifacts ~50m. Will post pass/fail and attach logs.
emily-qa: Started. Quick note: enabling verbose KV logging in the run to surface any header mismatch. If anything odd, will retry with reduced concurrency.
jun: Dashboard hook added: new panel filters by `runtime=3.2.1_unpinned` and `cohort=eu-canary`. Also wired the alert to deploy-bot and to PagerDuty.
alex: Rollback playbook snippet (short): 1) deploy-bot auto-pin (or manual `deploybot pin --runtime v3.2.1`) 2) capture traces and sample requests 3) notify customer success if any dedicated fleet customers are impacted 4) open postmortem if >15min outage or degraded SLA for >30m.
sam: Note: dedicated/reserved fleets are unaffected by this canary change — only hosted EU canary traffic moves. Customer-facing pinned versions remain stable.
emily-qa: Longseq halfway, no KV errors in initial 20m. Uploading interim logs: https://artifacts.internal/longseq/8065432100/partial.log
alex: If no red flags after the 30m hold, we'll ramp to 20% for 1h then full roll. I'll prepare the changelog entry and include the SDK header migration note.
maria: A small ask: add a quick `curl` example for SDK header compatibility in the changelog so integrators have a copy-paste.
sam: I'll add the snippet and ping the community channel after release.
deploy-bot: executed: unpin started at 22:45 UTC, cohort A at 5% -> monitoring. Will post updates and final status when complete.
